title: The Humble Advice of the Assembly of Divines ... Concerning a Confession of Faith (Westminster Confession of Faith)

title: The Cathechisme or manner how to instruct and teach children and others in the Christian faith (the Heidelberg Catechism)

license: public domain (1578; EEBO-TCP Phase II keyed transcription, freed from restriction 1 Aug. 2020)
notes: Whole catechism, 129 questions (STC 13029; TCP A02885). The 1764 New York translation (Evans-TCP N07592) was checked but is missing Q2-9 and Q38 in the transcription. EEBO-TCP keyed transcription; long s normalised; marginal Scripture references inlined as [marg.: ...]; illegibility marks kept. Original spelling kept.
